captions.instagram:
Stream GTA VI from a spare room? 🎮 It may count as a home office, but only if it passes two rules.

Myth: "I stream from home, so my whole home is a write-off."
Fact: only the part you use regularly and exclusively for the business counts.

✔️ A room used only for streaming: can count.
✔️ The couch where you also watch TV: no.
✔️ Simplified method: a set rate per square foot, up to 300 square feet. Or use actual expenses.

Measure the room and keep it business-only. Comment STREAM with your creator tax question.

Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.youtube_title: Streaming Room as a Home Office? The 2 IRS Rules
captions.youtube_description: A room you use regularly and exclusively for your streaming business may qualify for the home office deduction. The simplified option is $5 per square foot of home used for business, up to 300 square feet; or use actual expenses. Mixed personal use does not qualify. Sources: IRS 'Simplified option for home office deduction', Publication 587. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
